contexts.text: The Lord does not rest until love acts as principal.
As combat then ceases, the Lord is said to rest from all His work; and therefore the Sabbath was so called from rest. AC 85.
The rest of the celestial man described by the Sabbath. Illustrated.
As the Lord alone has fought for man, it is said that He rested.
The ark rested () = regeneration. Explained.
The spiritual man, after he has undergone temptations, in like manner becomes the rest of the Lord.
The rest of the celestial man is expressed by a word which means Sabbath, but the rest of the spiritual man by another word, from which Noah is named, which properly means rest.
The spiritual man is a holy rest, from the new intellectual lumen which is of charity.
The dove found no rest for the sole of her foot () = that nothing of the good and truth of faith could as yet take root. Explained.
When corporeal and voluntary things... are quiescent, the Lord operates... When the body is quiescent, he is in heat. AC 933:4.
They never acquiesce, to eternity.

There is no separation (of evil), but quiescence... It seems to be separated when it is quiescent... Nor does it quiesce... except from the Lord; and when it thus quiesces, goods inflow from the Lord... With the Angels there is only a detention from evil, thus a quiescence...
When cupidities... are quiescent in (the unregenerate)...
With the evil also... there is only a quiescence of corporeal and worldly things...
In a quiet dream I saw...
A very pleasant rest... affected me.
(The two lower degrees) are quiescent with (one in the Inmost Heaven), almost as the Corporeal is quiescent during sleep...
(During) interior thought... the things below are quiescent.
Each degree is (then) a plane, in which rests... the good which inflows...
An odour of rest (, ) = what is grateful from the good of love.

He saw rest that it was good () = the works of good without reward full of happiness. Rest = the things which are of Heaven, thus which are in the good of charity, or in works of good without reward... For rest, or peace, in the supreme sense, = the Lord; in the relative, Heaven, and thus the good which is from Him; and as no others are in these things which are signified by rest, or peace, than those who are in the good of charity, thus in works of good without reward, these are signified by rest. AC 6392. Further explained.
Life inflows... and does not rest except in the ultimate of order, where it stands still.
(The locust) rested in all the boundary () = ... that falsity pervaded from the extremes.
When those in Hell are in a quiet state...

Rest () = a state of peace, when there is no temptation; for a rest such as there was on the days of the Sabbath, was a representative of a state of peace, in which there is a conjunction of good and truth. Explained.

When the Angels are in this state, they have peace and rest; and the Lord also has rest; for, when they have been conjoined with Him, they labour no more... The rest of the Lord is signified by (His resting) on the seventh day. AC 8506, Explained. AC 8510.
Rest ye everyone under himself () = a state of peace. Explained.
The mind then rests and is serene...
And rested on the seventh day () = peace then, and the good of love. Explained.
As soon as the good of love has been implanted, combat ceases, and rest ensues; for the man is then introduced into Heaven...
To sleep = to rest; here, upon the external Sensuous. Explained.
They cease in it, and thus rest upon it. (Thus) the interiors of the body rest upon the skin. The viscera of the abdomen rest upon the peritoneum.
So the things which relate to the Intellectual and Voluntary... rest upon the sensuous things which communicate with the world; for they cease in them.
Moreover, all things progress from the First... to their ultimates, and there rest... Therefore the human race is the ultimate... in which Heaven ceases, and on which it rests.
How the case is with the Testing-quiescentia of interiors upon ultimates.
This state is what is meant by... the land resting (). Explained.
To cease, or rest from works () = the tranquillity of peace then. AC 9280.
In (the ultimate) they cease and rest. AC 9430:2.
The things of the external memory... then are quiescent. HH 355. HH 464:2. NJHD 51:8.
An odour of rest () = a perceptivity of peace. HH 287:3, Illustrated. AE 365:end.
This Sensuous then is quiescent.
There is no rest from evils and falsities until good and truth have been conjoined. Then man has rest, and the Lord has rest; for man does not fight... but the Lord in him.

On the seventh day He rested and breathed () = a state of good when the Church has been instaurated, or when man has been regenerated... In the supreme sense, by... the rest and breathing of Jehovah is signified the union of the Divine Itself and the Divine Human... Explained.
There was then a rest and breathing of Heaven...
Thus the rest of Jehovah = peace and salvation for the Angels and for men: to the latter when they are in good, and thereby in the Lord.
I will cause thee (Moses) to rest () = the external of the Church, etc., in which Divine interior things cease... To rest = to rest, and cease... Explained.
On the seventh day thou shalt rest () = the second state of regeneration, when man is in good, and then in peace.
In ploughing and harvest thou shalt rest () = (the second state of regeneration) as to the implantation of truth in good, and its reception.
Nor do they rest until they are in the Hells with their own.
No happiness consists in the fact that they rest.
Certain Spirits lapsed into quiet, as in sleep...
The ultimate plane... is then quiescent... and upon this plane the interiors... rest, like a house on its foundation.
Creation there... subsists in its rest.
Substances at rest...
Ultimates, which are relatively in a state of rest...
Cartilages and bones, upon which they rest and subsist.
This communication (of the Natural with the Spiritual) is not felt except by a certain rest and peace of mind... especially after combats...
a. [end]. The ultimates of life... after death, are quiescent...
Internal rest taken away. Signified, Explained.
That they should rest yet a little while () = that the Last Judgment would be delayed a little. AE 396.
They shall have no rest day and night () = their perpetual state in undelightful things after death. ( = continual infestation. AE 890.) (Compare AE 247, AE 285.)
They shall rest from their labours () = that those who have been tempted will have peace in the Lord. AR 640. AE 900.
By peace is meant the rest of the soul when no longer infested as before by evils and falsities.
(The notion that) after death there is a plenary rest from labours, and that this rest consists in... CL 207. CL 207:3. TCR 694.
(Three degrees) in the quiescent things of which the terraqueous globe consists.
The last (encompassing sphere) consists of quiescent things.
Human reason does not rest unless it sees the cause.
Into which He can extend His love, and exercise it, and so rest.
Love and wisdom (then) rest as in their house.
The seventh day represented His victory over the Hells, and thus rest. TCR 302:2.
That day (then) became a day of instruction in Divine things, and thus also a day of rest from labours...
On a state of quiet of the lower mind... SE 2342.
Those in a quiet state, that is, those whom the Lord keeps in a state of quiet (are safe) from evil Spirits...

But a state of quiet is not a state of cupidities. A state of the cupidities in which a man is delighted, is the state of quiet of evil Spirits, and is turned, in the other life, into a turbulent state.
When (evil Spirits) have hope of doing evil, they... are at rest... Thus they also have a quiet life, from hope.
The things which cause gravity, rest, cold, etc.
No happiness consists in being at rest.
There was such a quiet (in the interior Heaven) as cannot be described.
This was to them as a sweet rest.

When the Angels with a man are in such things... there inflows with him... quiet, etc. of the lower mind; but when such things are not in the faith and affection of the man, there inflows inquietude, etc.
Those in that Heaven have an external, like all Spirits, but it is quiescent with them... thus it is quiescent like a man's external when he is asleep. (See also SE 5549.)
As those in this peace are called the quiet, it is said, quiet be those who love thee ()... Quiet in thy palaces = in the interior man.
Quietness () is predicated of the peace therein... Tranquil quietnesses () = the delights of good and the pleasant things of truth.
Waters of quietnesses () = the truths of Heaven thence.
They have quiet in their evils and falsities...
Arise Jehovah to Thy rest () = the unition of the Divine Itself with the Human, and thence peace. AE 700:10.
The resting of the ark () = the state after temptations when evils and falsities have been removed.
To give rest to the earth () = protection from falsities.
